text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Most common items of waste in the ocean by region
Each item's share of total litter in nearshore waters, which are within 100 kilometers of the coast.

tspan.tspan: Data comes from global samples of more than 12 million litter items in major aquatic environments. This is shown for the 10 most

text.tspan: common items in each region, based on the counts/number of items found.
